mechanism_narrative: Lower levels of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 7.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to the interaction effect.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term is not significant in a regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to the interaction effect.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term is not significant in a regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a potential setback in economic recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative in post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
